methods.summary: The study sampled beetles and plants across various habitats (semi-natural and farmland) in different regions of Eastern China, detailing the types of crops and vegetation present in these areas. The study measured the body size of individual carabid specimens and surveyed plant species richness and percentage coverage across various sampling events at different sites.

results.summary: The study measured the species composition, feeding traits, and diversity of 119 species of carabids across different land-use types (perennial crops, semi-natural habitats, and annual crops), examining how these factors influenced carabid abundance and richness.
